Context: DOOM64 browser clone at `/mnt/dados/projom/doom/`. Read `/mnt/dados/projetos/doom/DOOM64_SPEC.md` and `/mnt/dados/projetos/doom/DOOM64_CONTRACT.md` for interfaces.

**T1: Create these EXACT files NOW (write every file, do not just analyze):**

1. `/mnt/dados/projetos/doom/index.html` — `<canvas id="renderCanvas">`, `<div id="hud">`, `<script type="module" src="./src/main.ts">`.
2. `/mnt/dados/projetos/doom/style.css` — HUD: health bar red bottom-left, armor blue, ammo bottom-center, score top-right, crosshair, menus. monospace font.
3. `/mnt/dados/projetos/doom/vite.config.ts` — base: './'.
4. `/mnt/dados/projetos/doom/package.json` — deps: babylonjs@9; dev: typescript, vite, vitest, playwright, @types/node. Scripts dev/build/test/e2e.
5. `/mnt/dados/projetos/doom/tsconfig.json` — ES modules, Babylon types, strict.
6. `/mnt/dados/projetos/doom/src/types.ts` — `Vec3 = BABYLON.Vector3`, `Vec2 = {x:number;y:number}`, `AIState` enum (SLEEP|WAKE|CHASE|ATTACK|DEAD), `IEnemy` (id, position:Vec3, health, maxHealth, speed, state, attackCooldown, isBoss, takeDamage(amount:number):void, update(dt,playerPos,playerHeading):void, render(scene:BABYLON.Scene):void, dispose():void), `IWeapon` (id, name, maxAmmo, currentAmmo, fireRateRPM, damage, reloadTime, type:'hitscan'|'cone'|'projectile', spreadDegrees?, overheats?, maxOverheat?), `GameState` = 'MENU'|'PLAYING'|'PAUSED'|'GAMEOVER'|'VICTORY', `Tile` = 0|1|2.
7. `/mnt/dados/projetos/doom/src/config/weapons.ts` — export const WEAPONS: IWeapon[] = [pistol, shotgun, chaingun, rocket, bfg]. pistol: {id:'pistol',name:'Pistol',maxAmmo:30,currentAmmo:30,fireRateRPM:163.6,damage:25,reloadTime:1.0,type:'hitscan'}. shotgun: {id:'shotgun',name:'Shotgun',maxAmmo:8,currentAmmo:8,fireRateRPM:56.8,damage:35,reloadTime:2.2,type:'cone',spreadDegrees:60}. chaingun: {id:'chaingun',name:'Chaingun',maxAmmo:50,currentAmmo:50,fireRateRPM:530,damage:9,reloadTime:2.4,type:'hitscan',overheats:true,maxOverheat:1.0}. rocket: {id:'rocket',name:'Rocket Launcher',maxAmmo:20,currentAmmo:20,fireRateRPM:40,damage:200,reloadTime:2.5,type:'projectile'}. bfg: {id:'bfg',name:'BFG 9000',maxAmmo:1,currentAmmo:1,fireRateRPM:56,damage:2060,reloadTime:3.0,type:'hitscan'}.
8. `/mnt/dados/projetos/doom/src/config/enemies.ts` — export const ENEMIES: IEnemy[] = [zombie, imp, demon, cacodemon, mancus, baron, hellknight]. zombie: {id:'zombie',name:'Zombie',hp:100,maxHealth:100,speed:40,attackDamage:25,attackRange:2.0,attackInterval:1.5,type:'zombie'}. imp: {id:'imp',name:'Imp',hp:60,maxHealth:60,speed:60,attackDamage:20,attackRange:25,attackInterval:1.5,type:'imp'}. demon: {id:'demon',name:'Demon',hp:120,maxHealth:120,speed:80,attackDamage:35,attackRange:30,attackInterval:1.0,type:'demon'}. cacodemon: {id:'cacodemon',name:'Cacodemon',hp:400,maxHealth:400,speed:80,attackDamage:64,attackRange:12,attackInterval:2.0,type:'cacodemon',teleportRange:12}. mancus: {id:'mancubus',name:'Mancubus',hp:600,maxHealth:600,speed:60,attackDamage:30,attackRange:20,attackInterval:2.5,type:'mancubus',fireballCount:3}. baron: {id:'baron',name:'Baron of Hell',hp:800,maxHealth:800,speed:50,attackDamage:40,attackRange:15,attackInterval:2.0,type:'baron',isBoss:false}. hellknight: {id:'hellknight',name:'Hell Knight',hp:500,maxHealth:500,speed:70,attackDamage:35,attackRange:25,attackInterval:1.5,type:'hellknight'}.
9. `/mnt/dados/projetos/doom/src/config/levels.ts` — export const LEVELS: Array<{name:string, grid:number[][], width:number, height:number, tileUnit:number, enemySpawns:Array<{x:number;z:number;type:string}>[], pickups:Array<{x:number;z:number;kind:string}>[]}>. Create MAP1 "The Armory" 24x24 with 6 zombies+2 imps, MAP2 "The Catacombs" 30x30 with 4 demons+2 mancus+3 barons, MAP3 "The Mother Chamber" 32x32 with 2 cacodemons+2 hellknights. Use wall=1, empty=0.
10. `/mnt/dados/projetos/doom/tests/config.test.ts` — import {WEAPONS,ENEMIES,LEVELS} from '../src/config'; assert WEAPONS.length===5 and each has id/name/maxAmmo/fireRateRPM/damage/reloadTime/type; assert ENEMIES.length===7 and each has id/name/hp/maxHealth/speed/attackDamage/attackRange; assert each LEVEL grid rows all equal width.

**MANDATE: Write ALL 10 files. Verify each exists with `ls`. Then run `npm install && npm test` and report PASS. Do NOT stop to analyze — produce the files.**
